Confirmed only the 1756 diagnostic is in scope. Now producing the JSON response.

```json
{"file": "src/packages/agent/query.ts",
 "edits": [{"old": "    const fileChangeAttachmentCount = count(
      toolResults,
      tr =>
        tr.type === 'attachment' && tr.attachment.type === 'edited_text_file',
    )",
            "new": "    const fileChangeAttachmentCount = count(toolResults, tr => {
      if (tr.type !== 'attachment') return false
      const attachment = tr.attachment
      return (
        typeof attachment === 'object' &&
        attachment !== null &&
        'type' in attachment &&
        attachment.type === 'edited_text_file'
      )
    })"}],
 "patterns": [{"patron": "agent-message-index-signature-unknown-property",
               "senal_del_verificador": "query\.ts.*TS18046: 'tr\.attachment' is of type 'unknown'",
               "fix_generico": "En `query.ts`, los alias `AttachmentMessage`/`UserMessage`/`Message` apuntan todos a `AgentMessage` (internalTypes.ts), cuya única forma de acceso a propiedades no declaradas explícitamente es el índice `[key: string]: unknown`. Narrow con `tr.type === 'attachment'` no afina el tipo de `tr.attachment` porque no es una unión discriminada — sigue siendo `unknown`. Se resuelve sin cast: extraer el valor a una variable y narrowarla con `typeof x === 'object' && x !== null && 'type' in x` antes de comparar `x.type`, que TypeScript permite comparar contra un literal sin error aunque siga siendo `unknown` tras el `in`.",
```
